statement.statement_label: For every integer n at least 2, there exist positive integers x, y, z such that 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z.

definitions_and_conventions.statement_scope: The endpoint variable n ranges over all integers n at least two; x, y, and z are positive integers. Bounded packets may study exact subfamilies without changing that endpoint.

definitions.meaning: A triple (x,y,z) of positive integers satisfying 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z exactly.
The universal existence assertion for every integer n at least two, distinguished from reductions, finite checks, density bounds, and analogies.

conventions.label: symmetric ordering
conventions.text: Because the equation is symmetric, a certificate may report x≤y≤z; this normalization is not an additional existence hypothesis.

conventions.label: bounded-result discipline
conventions.text: A theorem about one modulus, carrier, residue class, or finite search remains bounded to its stated hypotheses unless an explicit map and proof establish a broader implication.
